Scores on certain standardized test, IQ scores, are approximately normally distributed with mean µ=100 and standard deviation $\sigma=15$

$\frac{1-0.954}{2}$

# example
needs score about 820 on SATs
Scores from 2018 were approximately $N(1019,209^{2})$ what percentage of students had SAT scores of at least 820


 $Z_{1}= \frac{x_{1}-1019}{209}=1.28$

$x_{1}=209·1.28+1019=1280$
